binding_checks: Pinned complete inventory count, byte count, member set and each member SHA256.

Every allocated acquisition linked by ID, capture role, operation, interval, record sequence, episode, physical-state hash, original camera, observation checksum and registered camera/optical depth. Every original source-frame was reconstructed.
Each blob matches the per-frame and inventory hashes; RGB-D validation verifies the valid mask is exactly positive finite depth.

lift.link_rule: Compare supports at adjacent physical steps using at least one identical image pixel. Multiple connected spatial traces remain unlabeled; overlap is descriptive.

limitations: Color-matched fragments have no unique target association or complete silhouette.
A successfully decoded unique mounted marker gives an ordered sample pose. Neither registration nor the sensor supplies a calibrated metric error envelope.

A square colored fragment has quarter-turn ambiguity. Ordered tag corners can distinguish orientation at a decoded sample only. Consecutive samples cannot exclude intervening translation, oscillation or complete turns.

lift.step_selection: Use the original PRE/POST boundary acquisitions at 4200/6240 and the independently registered per-physics-step acquisition at each intermediate step.

offline_simulator_attribution.inference: Neither offline labels nor physics residuals enter a detector or tracker verdict.
offline_simulator_attribution.label_semantics: A labeled cell contributes at least one sampled pixel. A missing ID may reflect occlusion or rasterization. Two-pass acquisitions have no instance image.

localization_on_failed_or_recovered_acqu.scope: External instance-cell bounds locate the tag in original RGB for attribution only. Corner distances are descriptive and never alter detector gates.

offline_simulator_attribution.metric: Maximum point distance over eight vertices, three contacts and registered TCP.

r593.all_frame_gate_policy: Frozen default NONE and alternative SUBPIX are reported separately. No policy or asset change.
r593.boundary_semantics: A shared POST/PRE acquisition is counted once in the ending step range. Each original tracker use appears in the clock list.

NONE/known_marker_not_observed.diagnostic: No decoded ID; rejected quads alone cannot distinguish physical occlusion, raster sampling, contrast or dictionary mismatch.

SUBPIX/known_marker_not_observed.diagnostic: No decoded ID; rejected quads alone cannot distinguish physical occlusion, raster sampling, contrast or dictionary mismatch.

SUBPIX/registered_marker_size_inconsiste.diagnostic: Frozen detector's first failing gate. Later gates are unevaluated.

r593.run_semantics: Consecutive rows in the named population in allocation order. Global spans contain every allocated acquisition; step numbers may repeat.

sensor_time.clock_basis: Recorded evaluation UTC is used only for an original tracker call. Other archived pixels have sensor capture UTC and simulation time but no original tracker evaluation time.
